name: Activity type: Band retrieval
abstract: Retrieves one band, one range component, of an Earth observation product as a raster, over the whole product or over an area of interest, with the values the product provides, possibly converted to physical units by the scale and offset the product declares.

sources.title: OGC 12-040 Web Coverage Service Interface Standard - Range Subsetting Extension 1.0, §1 Scope (retrieval of selected range components of a coverage)
